    🔌 Discoms & demand

    🧠 How the power model works (game mechanics)

    • Adequacy = the tightest of three checks: evening firm capacity vs evening peak (≈92% of peak), midday capacity (incl. solar) vs peak, and annual energy. Firm-capacity factors (game assumptions): coal 0.85, gas 0.5, nuclear 0.85, hydro 0.45, wind 0.12, solar 0 at evening / 0.55 midday, storage = GWh ÷ 4 h.
    • Curtailment happens when solar+wind exceed the grid's integration headroom. Transmission and storage add headroom. Curtailment scares developers and raises costs.
    • ACS–ARR gap moves with AT&C losses, tariff stance, fuel shocks, curtailment and buying scarce power. A gap above ₹0.40/kWh for 2+ years triggers a discom crisis.
    • Investor confidence in new solar/wind falls with curtailment and discom payment risk.
    • Coal starts retiring 2.5 GW/yr from 2035 (assumption). Battery costs fall each year, so storage gets cheaper to build.

    🎯 Milestones & Viksit Bharat yardsticks

    "Official" = a stated government/World Bank figure (see ). "Game" = a design yardstick, not an official target.

    ❓ How to play

    1. You are India's national planner from 2026 to 2047, over seven 3-year terms.
    2. Each term opens with an event card. Pick a response; every option has trade-offs. (Monsoons, oil shocks, heat domes, pandemics, breakthroughs…)
    3. Spend your development budget (points scale with GDP) across 8 national sectors and 6 power levers. Returns diminish: 8 points is not twice as good as 4.
    4. Pick one policy card (optional) and set the retail tariff stance. You can borrow extra points, but debt drags growth.
    5. Hit "Enact" to simulate 3 years. Watch the report card, the brief, and milestone celebrations.
    6. Synergies: infrastructure + reliable power supercharge industry. Digital boosts governance. Education raises the payoff from industry (after a lag).
    7. Keep the people with you: if approval ends a term below 20%, you're out of office.
    8. In 2047 you're scored against Viksit Bharat yardsticks: NITI Aayog's US$30 trillion / US$18,000 per capita aspiration, energy & climate targets, human development, governance and fiscal health.

    Tap any ⓘ or KPI card for the real-world source. Baselines are real (mostly mid-2026). All future dynamics are invented game mechanics, simplified for playability. This is not a forecast.
